semantics: Dense packed6 code tables compare explicit non-compressible and driver-confirmed generic-compressible VMM allocations. zero6, periodic6 and entropy6 provide increasing information density; every decoded code is checked in the timed kernels.
scope_note: Throughput and capacity curves can reveal a workload-level benefit or lack thereof, but do not expose achieved hardware compression ratio, compressed L2 bytes, DRAM traffic or compression counters.
